noWallet.title: Samun Walat ta Cardano
noWallet.body: Walat ta Cardano tana ba ku damar ajiye ADA (kuɗin Cardano) da kuma biyan ƙaramin kuɗi don wallafa ƙuduri. Masu kaɗa ƙuri'a ba sa buƙatarta ko kaɗan — masu ƙirƙirar ƙudurori kaɗai ke buƙatarta.
noWallet.step1: Ku sauke <bold>Vespr</bold> — ita ce walat ɗin Cardano mafi sauƙi ga sababbi, an yi ta don waya.
noWallet.step2: Ku ƙirƙiri walat ɗinku sannan ku rubuta kalmomin dawo da ita (recovery phrase) ku ajiye su a wuri mai aminci.
noWallet.step3: Ku saka ADA kaɗan — na 'yan daloli ya isa don wallafa ƙudurori.
noWallet.step4: Ku dawo nan, ku taɓa Vespr, sannan ku liƙa adireshinku.
noWallet.linkErrorMessage: Ku nemi "Vespr Wallet" a Play Store.

batching.title: Tsarin Haɗa Ƙuri'u Rukuni-rukuni
batching.body:
Ana haɗa ƙuri'u har 100 a rukuni ɗaya don rage kuɗi
Ƙananan rukunoni ana aika su da kansu bayan kowane minti 10
Ana rubuta dukkan ƙuri'u idan ƙuduri ya ƙare
Ragin kuɗi 80% idan aka kwatanta da aika kowace ƙuri'a ita kaɗai
Kaɗa ƙuri'a KYAUTA ne gaba ɗaya ga mahalarta
